content.text: The project (€160,242) faces significant specification deficiencies, primarily violating VOB/C §4.2 and relevant DIN standards. High-risk gaps include missing insulation details, technical specifications for excavation depths, and waterproofing parameters, which jeopardize compliance and cost certainty. Medium-risk issues involve undefined asphalt, masonry, and concrete details, alongside an unfair risk transfer clause regarding site setup. These omissions create substantial estimating uncertainty and potential for change orders. Immediate action is required to clarify technical parameters, define risk allocation, and ensure regulatory compliance before finalizing the estimate.
